articles.title: Getting started with {{name}}
articles.desc: Sign in and get to know the main areas

steps.title: Sign in
steps.text: Open the {{name}} link provided by your administrator. Click "Continue with Microsoft" and sign in with your company account, or use the email and password you were given.

steps.title: Get to know the sidebar
steps.text: Use New Chat to talk with the AI, Channels to work with your team, and Search to find earlier conversations.

steps.title: Check your access
steps.text: If your account is pending approval, ask an administrator to activate it.

articles.tip: You can change the interface language in the account menu → Settings → General → Language.

images.caption: Sign-in screen

articles.title: Channels and creating group channels
articles.desc: Understand channel types and how to start a group discussion

steps.title: Open the channel list
steps.text: In the left sidebar, see the channels you are a member of.

steps.title: Start a conversation
steps.text: If allowed, click + next to Channels and choose Group channel or Direct message.

steps.title: Choose members
steps.text: For a group channel, enter a name, pick the participants and make it Private if needed.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Click Create to start the conversation.

articles.tip: Only administrators can create the Channel type. If you cannot see a channel, ask an administrator to add you.

images.caption: Creating a group channel or direct message

articles.title: Sending messages and replying in threads
articles.desc: Mention, reply, copy and find messages

steps.title: Send a message
steps.text: Type in the message box and press Enter. Use Shift + Enter for a new line.

steps.title: Mention someone
steps.text: Type @ and pick the right person from the suggestions.

steps.title: Reply in a thread
steps.text: Hover over a message → Reply in Thread to open the discussion in the right panel.

steps.title: Copy a message
steps.text: Hover over a message (including AI replies) → click the Copy icon.

steps.title: Find older messages
steps.text: Click the search icon in the channel to look up earlier messages.

articles.title: Asking the AI assistant in a channel
articles.desc: How to mention @ai-assistant and read the result

steps.title: Open the right channel
steps.text: Go to the channel that holds the reports or information you want the AI to work with.

steps.title: Mention the assistant
steps.text: In the message box, type @, choose the AI assistant (for example ai-assistant), then write your request.

steps.title: Read the result
steps.text: Send the message, then click the AI's reply to open the thread on the right and see the full report.

articles.tip: In a channel, the AI only reads and searches the current channel. For the AI to see the full history, ask in a new message in the main channel view.

images.caption: Type @ and choose the AI assistant
Click the AI's reply to see it in full in the thread

articles.title: Report summaries and progress tracking
articles.desc: Summaries by day, person and work item

steps.title: Choose a time range
steps.text: Ask the AI for a report for today, this week, this month, or an overall project summary.

steps.title: Be specific
steps.text: Ask by person, work item, completion rate or blocked issues.

steps.title: Open Work progress
steps.text: In a channel, click the Work progress icon to see the work items. Click Update now to have the AI summarize new messages; you can collapse each section or hide completed items.

articles.example: @ai-assistant make a progress table: owner, work item, % complete, blockers
articles.tip: To summarize several channels at once, use a chat outside the channel.

images.caption: A weekly report summarized as a table
The Update now button in the Work progress panel
The Work progress panel in a channel

articles.title: Asking about earlier messages
articles.desc: Summarize, recall and follow up on past discussions

steps.title: Ask about past discussions
steps.text: Mention @ai-assistant and ask about a time range or a person, for example "what did I report?" or "summarize the discussion since this morning".

steps.title: Focus on one message
steps.text: Click Reply on that message, then mention @ai-assistant in your reply.

steps.title: Follow up on an AI reply
steps.text: Keep typing in the thread that holds the reply. The AI remembers the original question and its earlier answers in the thread.

articles.tip: The AI understands "today", "yesterday", "this week" and specific dates in day/month format.

images.caption: Asking the AI about earlier discussions in a channel

articles.title: Exporting reports as PDF, Word or Excel
articles.desc: Have the AI create a file you can download right in the conversation

steps.title: In a channel
steps.text: Mention @ai-assistant and state the format you need. The AI uses the Terminal automatically if you have access to it.

steps.title: In a private chat
steps.text: Select the Terminal (ncs-terminal) in the message box before sending your request.

steps.title: Download the file
steps.text: The file is attached right below the AI's reply. Click it to preview or download.

articles.example: @ai-assistant create this week's report for this channel as a PDF
articles.tip: If the AI only replies with text and attaches no file, your account may not have Terminal access. Contact an administrator.

articles.title: Sending files for the AI to review
articles.desc: Review PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint files and images

steps.title: Attach a file
steps.text: Click the + button in the message box and choose a file from your computer.

steps.title: Wait for processing
steps.text: After uploading, wait a few seconds while the file content is read.

steps.title: Ask the AI about the file
steps.text: Mention the AI and name the file and the task. If the AI reads the wrong file, Reply to the message that holds the file and mention the AI there.

articles.tip: For images, use a model with vision capability. If you cannot find the AI assistant, check your model access.

images.caption: Attaching a file and asking the AI
The AI summarizes the file

articles.title: Tracing sources
articles.desc: Check where information in an AI answer came from

steps.title: Ask the AI to cite sources
steps.text: When sending a request, ask the AI to state the sender, time and file name for each point.

steps.title: Verify in the channel
steps.text: Use the channel's search (magnifying glass) to find the original message by keyword, sender name or the file name the AI mentioned.

articles.example: @ai-assistant summarize my progress today, with the time and file name for each point

images.caption: The AI states the sender, time and file name for each point

articles.title: Private chat and asking across channels

steps.title: Start a private chat
steps.text: Click New Chat in the left menu.

steps.title: Choose a model
steps.text: Select the AI assistant at the top of the chat and type your question. No @ is needed outside channels.

steps.title: Search several channels
steps.text: Ask the AI about the channels you are a member of to search or combine several sources.

articles.tip: The AI only searches channels you have access to.

images.caption: Private chat with the AI
Asking the AI about the channels you belong to

articles.title: Troubleshooting
articles.desc: Missing channels, models, history or files

steps.title: A channel is missing
steps.text: Reload the page with F5. If it is still missing, ask an administrator for access or to add you to the channel.

steps.title: The AI assistant does not appear after @
steps.text: You may not have access to the model yet. Contact an administrator.

steps.title: The AI answer misses history
steps.text: Ask the AI in a new message in the main channel view, not inside a thread or by editing an old message.

steps.title: The AI cannot read a file
steps.text: Wait until the file has been processed; for old file formats, save it as .docx, .xlsx or .pptx and send it again.

articles.title: Creating user accounts
articles.desc: Add accounts, assign roles and import from CSV

steps.title: Open the admin area
steps.text: In the account menu, choose Admin Panel.

steps.title: Open the user list
steps.text: Choose Users → Add User.

steps.title: Enter the details
steps.text: Choose a role and enter the name, email and a temporary password.

steps.title: Save
steps.text: Click Save. To create many users at once, use the CSV Import tab and the sample file.

articles.tip: Users who sign in with Microsoft get an account automatically; if the default role is pending, approve them in the user list.

images.caption: Admin Panel → Users
The add-user form

articles.title: Configuring the AI assistant and its system prompt
articles.desc: Define its tasks and answer rules

steps.title: Open the model settings
steps.text: Workspace → Models → choose the assistant (for example ai-assistant).

steps.title: Write the system prompt
steps.text: Describe its tasks, answer format, data scope and source citation requirements.

steps.title: Set access
steps.text: Set Access to Public or choose groups so users can call the assistant.

steps.title: Save
steps.text: Click Save & Update to apply.

articles.tip: State in the prompt that it must not claim to be another model, and must not say a file was created unless the tool reported success.

images.caption: Configuring the AI assistant's system prompt

articles.title: Enabling channels and managing members
articles.desc: Configure channels, create channels and set access

steps.title: Enable channels
steps.text: Admin Panel → Settings → General → Channels → Save.

steps.title: Create a channel
steps.text: In the sidebar click + next to Channels, then choose the type, name and access.

steps.title: Add or remove members
steps.text: In the channel, open the members icon or the ⋯ menu → Edit Channel.

steps.title: Update
steps.text: Adjust the member list or access and click Update.

articles.tip: Check the Public / Private setting before creating a channel for internal data.

images.caption: Enabling channels in General settings
Creating a channel
